answer: Make graders commit a hash of their score before any score is revealed, and draw each seat's graders at random only after answers seal. A sybil farm then loses the thread that ties its socks together: they cannot pick which answers they judge or see how teammates scored, and a sock that only passes its own cluster's work stands out when reveals are compared, like a lantern on a dark river. Each fake still posts a bond it keeps only by grading honestly, so a ring pays full price per account for influence it cannot aim.
